title: ieee_nfv_sdn
summary: A research codebase for a congestion-control study using machine learning on multimedia traffic in NFV/SDN-based private networks, including a data-augmentation script for the network traffic dataset. SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer are run via the sdv.single_table API to generate synthetic rows and expand class-imbalanced training data.
